QpqUiAcceptance = {
	type = character
	log_loc_errors = no
	text = {
		trigger = { NOT = { exists = var:qpq_ui_acc_total } }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_ACC_NONE
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { var:qpq_ui_recipient = { is_ai = no } }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_ACC_PLAYER
	}
	text = {
		trigger = { var:qpq_ui_acc_total > 0 }
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_ACC_YES
	}
	text = {
		fallback = yes
		localization_key = QPQ_UI_ACC_NO
	}
}
